title: LPL 2026 to Begin on July 17, Final Set for August 8
byline: The Lanka Premier League 2026 will begin on July 17 with an opening clash between Jaffna and Galle at the SSC Grounds. The final is scheduled for August 8 at the R. Premadasa International Cricket Stadium, while matches will also be played in Kandy and Dambulla.

title: Fighter jet crews parachute safely after collision at US air show
byline: Four crew members are in stable condition after two fighter jets collided mid-air during a US air show, officials say.

title: Sri Lanka launches digital relief systems for Cyclone Ditwah victims
byline: Sri Lanka on Monday launched two new digital platforms aimed at improving disaster relief services for communities affected by Cyclone Ditwah, with support from the Government of Norway, UNICEF Sri Lanka, and UN Volunteers.

title: Students agree to vacate disputed Malwana property
byline: A group of university students who had occupied the disputed Malwana residence since May 1 have agreed to vacate the premises following discussions with Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya today (18).

title: Over 5,200 people affected by adverse weather
byline: The Disaster Management Centre (DMC) said that 5,267 people from 1,582 families have been affected by the prevailing adverse weather conditions across the island.

title: Delays in licence renewals threaten supply of essential medicines
byline: Hundreds of import licence renewals are currently pending at the National Medicines Regulatory Authority (NMRA), creating serious disruptions to the pharmaceutical supply chain, the Sri Lanka Chamber of the Pharmaceutical Industry (SLCPI) said.

title: Trump warns ’clock is ticking’ for Iran as peace progress stalls
byline: US President Donald Trump has warned Iran the ’’clock is ticking’’ as talks to bring the war to an end have stalled.

title: Middle East war pushes CPC oil bill past US$1bn
byline: The Middle East war has taken its toll on Sri Lanka, with the oil import bill of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) exceeding US$ 1 billion during the first four months of this year, whereas it stood at only US$ 1.5 billion for the whole of 2025, an official said.

title: Police issue warning over rise in teenage pregnancies
byline: Sri Lanka Police issued an urgent public advisory in response to a reported rise in teenage and underage pregnancies, calling on parents, guardians and children to work together to prevent further incidents and protect children’s welfare.

title: Vehicle importers announce estimated vehicle price hikes
byline: The Vehicle Importers Association of Sri Lanka (VIASL) has announced the estimated price increases following the Government’s decision to impose a 50% surcharge on vehicle imports.

title: Animal Welfare Coalition proposes crematoriums for dogs
byline: The Animal Welfare Coalition (AWC) has highlighted the need to establish animal crematorium facilities for dogs, arguing that such services would allow pets and stray animals to be treated with dignity after death, similar to humans.

title: Is the govt. higher up considering inviting Opposition MPs?
byline: Following months of speculation of arguments and rifts within the NPP camp, the Daily Mirror reliably learns that some senior government members have told President Anura Kumara Dissanayake to consider inviting capable parliamentarians from the opposition to join the government in an attempt to take the nation forward.

title: DC’s Thriller over RR shakes up IPL 2026 Points Table
byline: Delhi Capitals kept their playoff hopes alive with a five-wicket win over Rajasthan Royals on May 17, further shaking up the IPL 2026 points table. While Royal Challengers Bengaluru became the first team to seal a playoff spot, the battle for the remaining knockout places is now tighter than ever.
